blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—La Salle shook up the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball standings even more on Saturday night after it slipped past rival Ateneo, 76-73, in overtime at Araneta Coliseum. The Green Archers escaped with their sixth victory in 10 games to overtake Far Eastern University (5-4) at No. 3 despite missing five of their last free throws in the final 17 seconds. “Every time we face Ateneo, we know it will be a good game,” said La Salle swingman JC Macalalag, who finished with 11 points, three rebounds and two steals to help the Archers notch their third consecutive win.
